$comment: The ticket worktrees /build builds in live at ../Auto-Chess-Game-work/issue-<n>/, outside this checkout. Without additionalDirectories, every read and edit in a claimed worktree prompts for directory access. It grants nothing the agent could not already reach through Bash — worktrees of this repo only — and the pre-push hook claim.mjs installs still means nothing publishes from there except through finish.mjs.
$comment_model: Pinned to Sonnet on cost: issue #5 built on Opus cost ~56% of a 5-hour window. The ticket-builder and pipeline-runner agents and the Claude reviewer (automation/settings/claude-review.json) pin the same model in their own files, so /build stays on Sonnet even in a session switched to /model opus.
$comment_permissions: allow is the unprompted dev loop the ticket-builder agent runs inside a worktree; a background agent's permission prompts land in your session, so without it every test run and commit would interrupt you. The rtk forms exist because the RTK hook rewrites commands before the permission check. deny mirrors .codex/rules/pipeline.rules so Claude and Codex share one boundary: publishing, merging and ticket-state changes go through automation/*.mjs, which run git and gh themselves and are unaffected. ask mirrors the one Codex 'prompt' rule.
